They offer coasteering, sea kayaking, canoeing, paddle boarding, white water rafting, gorge walking, and climbing in Cardigan Bay and along the Pembrokeshire coast — suitable for individuals, families, schools, corporate groups, and Duke of Edinburgh Award participants.

description.full:
Adventure Beyond is a family-run outdoor activity company founded in 1997 and based at Nant Y Popty Farm, Coed-y-bryn, Llandysul, Ceredigion SA44 5LQ in West Wales. Operating within reach of the Cardigan Bay coastline and the River Teifi, they offer adventurous experiences tailored to all abilities — from adrenaline-focused coasteering and white water rafting to relaxed family canoeing trips and sea kayaking with dolphin-spotting opportunities.

Activities include coasteering along the Pembrokeshire and Ceredigion coast, sea kayaking in Cardigan Bay, canoeing on the River Teifi, white water rafting and tubing, gorge walking, stand-up paddle boarding, hill walking, rock climbing, and abseiling. The company also runs residential school and youth group trips, Duke of Edinburgh Award expeditions at Bronze, Silver, and Gold levels, and corporate team-building events. Select residential programmes include bush craft sessions.

Adventure Beyond holds AALA licensing and is an accredited British Canoeing Delivery Partner, Canoe Wales member, National Coasteering Charter member, and WiSe (Wildlife Safe) Scheme operator. Their guides hold qualifications through the Institute for Outdoor Learning. The company has appeared in television productions including Don't Rock the Boat, Extreme Wales, and I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here.

Activities typically run year-round with booking by phone or via the website.
